scenes.text: The price of a loaf of bread, 1990–2020
scenes.narration: The price of a loaf of bread, from nineteen ninety to twenty twenty.

scenes.title: Bread, per pound
scenes.subtitle: US city average
scenes.caption: It more than doubled in thirty years.
scenes.narration: Bread cost about seventy cents a pound in nineteen ninety. By twenty twenty, it was one fifty four.

scenes.label: Increase since 1990
scenes.caption: Slower than rent, faster than wages in some years.
scenes.narration: That is an increase of more than one hundred percent.
